signal: Sonatus raised a $75M round backed by Foxconn and continues expanding its AI software-defined vehicle business

email.body1:
Brian, saw Sonatus is scaling its AI software-defined vehicle platform on the back of the $75M Foxconn round.

Most RevOps teams at that stage have more in-market accounts than reps can touch, and the lag between a signal firing and a rep acting on it is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, closing that signal-to-action gap: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a personalized signal play for Sonatus off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Brian, quick follow-up for Sonatus.

The RevOps headache post-raise is usually data hygiene and slow signal-to-action, not effort. Reps burn hours on research and CRM logging instead of live conversations, and the measurable lift never shows up where leadership can see it.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and 3 changes I would make. Our best-practice lifts alone usually move reply rates 50-70%.
email.body3:
Brian, last bit of proof for Sonatus.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Sonatus's reply rate likely compares to other high-growth automotive software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Brian, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If tightening signal-to-action without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most mid-scale, and I know standing up clean RevOps motion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to Sonatus either way.
